resource_boundary.unreached_policy: Jump/set-animation/path commands and unsupported opcodes reject the whole runtime before publication. Pointer-driven model channel4 and camera channels28/32 reject; no ignored or synthesized values.
resource_boundary.ownership: Catalog and all nested resource/wire owners outlive Runtime and render/effect leases. Runtime predecodes command operands once and owns bounded persistent native state, not guest object pointers. No ROM or private decompressed payload table is published.

integration.schedule: Parent calls step_model(model index) and step_camera in actual OM process order, consumes every bounded ordered callback before next successful step, and composes all native node parents including real object root parent.
integration.render: Stable frame spans and per-node/material revisions; parent owns engine models/matrices/material commands. Node local revision does not replace descendant world invalidation when an ancestor moves.

integration.failure_atomicity: All stream framing/unsupported commands/graph associations validated before runtime publication. Event storage reserves the richest precompiled model program for every node plus one receiver END, covering later arbitrary bindings without update/switch allocation or capacity truncation. Bind/reset extents, program kinds/indices, material resources, nonfinite skips and retirement validate before any state/event mutation.
integration.lifecycle: create/reset restore source bind and MObj initial values, zero new tracks, select receiver, mark camera caches dirty; first update time0. restart models/camera uses animSet kind-only clearing and retained track fields, not rebinding. bind_model uses exact DFS program indices: non-null entries kind-only restart and select first receiver, null entries disable preserving old list/tracks/timePassed/flags/speed; optional restore uses original Catalog bind transforms for every node. bind_materials uses flattened attachment indices: null array/entries retain old programs/tracks/clocks/fields, even while object animation_time changes to skip. reset_materials selects initial resources, clears tracks/list and disables at time0/speed1 while retaining paletteIndex; empty selection restores every original attachment. All mutate stable storage and leave evaluation to explicit step_model after actor speed setters. Successful bind/reset invalidates borrowed events; consume ordered events immediately after evaluation before any further mutation. END applies final values once then disables. retire invalidates generation and stops updates; leases must already be released.
